modules.intended_role: canonical provider-specific resumable bulk acquisition, discovery, normalization, and streaming observation-routing adapter for complete GHCN-Daily station/inventory/by-year authorities, binding remote revision validators and final artifact digests while producing bounded federation catalog shards and spatial/year/element partition keys without station-by-time or per-station REST materialization
